data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: claw-code
ui_devex.summary: Claw-code 是一个基于 Rust 的工具包，旨在通过提供高效的 harness 工具来简化实际开发流程。其技术亮点在于利用 oh-my-codex 框架优化代码执行和工具集成，从而实现卓越的速度和可靠性。开发者可用它自动化重复编码任务、改进构建流程或集成自定义工具，为软件项目提供提升生产力的实用方案。
ui_devex.summary_en: Claw-code is a Rust-based toolkit designed to streamline real-world development workflows by providing efficient harness tools. Its technical distinction lies in leveraging the oh-my-codex framework to optimize code execution and tool integration, making it exceptionally fast and reliable. Developers can use it to automate repetitive coding tasks, enhance build processes, or integrate custom tools, offering a practical way to boost productivity in software projects.

ui_devex.name: axios
ui_devex.summary: Axios 是一个基于 Promise 的 HTTP 客户端库，统一了浏览器和 Node.js 环境中的网络请求处理，解决了不同平台 API 差异带来的开发复杂度。其核心技术在于自动的 JSON 数据转换和拦截器机制，让开发者能够优雅地插入认证、日志等通用逻辑。实际应用中，你可以快速将其集成到前端项目中进行 API 调用，或利用拦截器实现请求重试、错误统一处理等企业级功能，显著提升网络编程的效率和可维护性。
ui_devex.summary_en: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client that simplifies making API requests across browsers and Node.js environments, eliminating the complexity of native fetch APIs. Its elegant design automatically transforms JSON data and provides built-in request/response interceptors for seamless authentication and error handling. Developers can immediately integrate it into web apps for RESTful API calls, or extend its interceptors to implement custom logging, caching, or retry logic for robust network operations.

ui_devex.name: codex
ui_devex.summary: Codex 是一款轻量级终端编码助手，旨在为开发者提供无需依赖复杂 IDE 的即时代码辅助。它基于 OpenAI 的 Codex 模型，能够理解自然语言描述并实时生成代码片段或完整函数，核心在于将大语言模型的代码生成能力无缝嵌入命令行工作流。开发者可通过 cargo 安装，在终端中直接查询代码示例、自动补全常见操作或快速原型验证，特别适合日常脚本编写、API 探索或学习新语言时辅助实践。
ui_devex.summary_en: Codex is a lightweight coding agent that runs directly in your terminal, addressing the need for quick, context-aware code assistance without heavy IDE dependencies. It leverages OpenAI's Codex model to understand natural language queries and generate relevant code snippets or complete functions in real-time. Developers can integrate it into their workflow by installing via cargo, then using simple commands to get coding help, automate repetitive tasks, or explore new APIs hands-on.

ui_devex.name: claude-code
ui_devex.summary: Claude Code 是一款基于终端的AI编程助手，它通过自然语言命令帮助开发者自动化日常任务并理解复杂代码库。其核心在于能够分析整个代码仓库的上下文，直接在开发环境中提供智能建议并执行命令。你可以用它生成样板代码、调试现有函数或管理Git工作流——只需用简单英语描述需求，它就能处理具体的实现细节，让编程工作更高效直观。
ui_devex.summary_en: Claude Code is a terminal-based AI coding assistant that helps developers automate routine tasks and understand complex codebases through natural language commands. It works by analyzing your entire code repository context to provide intelligent suggestions and execute commands directly in your development environment. You can use it to generate boilerplate code, debug existing functions, or manage Git workflows—simply type your request in plain English and let it handle the implementation details.

agents_workflows.name: claude-code
agents_workflows.summary: Claude Code 是一款基于终端的AI编程助手，它通过自然语言命令帮助开发者自动化日常任务并理解复杂代码库。其核心在于能够分析整个代码仓库的上下文，直接在开发环境中提供智能建议并执行命令。你可以用它生成样板代码、调试现有函数或管理Git工作流——只需用简单英语描述需求，它就能处理具体的实现细节，让编程工作更高效直观。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Claude Code is a terminal-based AI coding assistant that helps developers automate routine tasks and understand complex codebases through natural language commands. It works by analyzing your entire code repository context to provide intelligent suggestions and execute commands directly in your development environment. You can use it to generate boilerplate code, debug existing functions, or manage Git workflows—simply type your request in plain English and let it handle the implementation details.

agents_workflows.name: codex
agents_workflows.summary: Codex 是一款轻量级终端编码助手，旨在为开发者提供无需依赖复杂 IDE 的即时代码辅助。它基于 OpenAI 的 Codex 模型，能够理解自然语言描述并实时生成代码片段或完整函数，核心在于将大语言模型的代码生成能力无缝嵌入命令行工作流。开发者可通过 cargo 安装，在终端中直接查询代码示例、自动补全常见操作或快速原型验证，特别适合日常脚本编写、API 探索或学习新语言时辅助实践。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Codex is a lightweight coding agent that runs directly in your terminal, addressing the need for quick, context-aware code assistance without heavy IDE dependencies. It leverages OpenAI's Codex model to understand natural language queries and generate relevant code snippets or complete functions in real-time. Developers can integrate it into their workflow by installing via cargo, then using simple commands to get coding help, automate repetitive tasks, or explore new APIs hands-on.

framework_core.summary_en: Claw-code is a Rust-based toolkit designed to streamline real-world development workflows by providing efficient harness tools. Its technical distinction lies in leveraging the oh-my-codex framework to optimize code execution and tool integration, making it exceptionally fast and reliable. Developers can use it to automate repetitive coding tasks, enhance build processes, or integrate custom tools, offering a practical way to boost productivity in software projects.
